jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description: Administrative Assistant This job provides administrative support to a team by preparing documents, managing databases, and maintaining records, including retrieving and searching files. The role will assist with the use of computers and office equipment and support the acquisition and maintenance of inventory, supplies, and equipment. This role helps coordinate documents and materials, manages incoming and outgoing mail, and uploads documents as required. Responsibilities may include providing reception services and responding to inquiries regarding program information. The role may also monitor and code expenditures, and prepare and process business expense forms, invoices, and contracts. Additionally, this role may be responsible for scheduling and making arrangements for meetings and training sessions.

jobs.title: Facility Service Worker This position provides maintenance support for government-owned and managed buildings, performing a variety of building and grounds maintenance duties. Responsibilities include assisting with HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, snow removal, lawn care, and operating manual and powered equipment. The role supports the operation of an educational facility and involves regular interaction with staff, students, contractors, and visitors while providing professional customer service and responding to maintenance requests. Duties include conducting routine inspections of mechanical and building systems, monitoring Building Management Systems (BMS/DDC), coordinating and escorting contractors, completing work orders through a computerized maintenance management system, and supporting overall building operations. The position requires adherence to safety standards, cleaning services, and physically demanding work including lifting, climbing ladders, and working at heights.

The role exercises independent judgment in assessing allegations, developing investigative strategies, managing evidence, conducting interviews, recommending enforcement outcomes, and supporting prosecutions, administrative actions, and judicial proceedings. The position also provides operational leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to Enforcement Officers and collaborates with law enforcement, regulatory agencies, Crown prosecutors, and other partners to ensure program integrity.
